Print a fit summary

Source: R/methods.R
print.summary.mfbdfm_fit.Rd

Print a fit summary

Usage

# S3 method for class 'summary.mfbdfm_fit'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object from summary.ind_dfm() or summary.fcast_dfm().

...

Ignored.

Value

x, invisibly.

Examples

# \donttest{
data(mfbdfm_example_data)
fit <- ind_dfm(mfbdfm_example_data, length_sample = 20, burn_in = 5)
#> preallocating..
